request.query: What do RightTroll accounts say about #maga?

response.answer:
In the retrieved sample, #MAGA is used as a pro-Trump rallying tag tied to praise of Trump, attacks on opponents/media, and culture-war policy themes.

- Celebrating Trump and his agenda: claims Trump "knows how to get success for the country" [T4-003807](#T4-003807); the Senate tax bill (TCJA, 51-49, with Corker the only GOP no) framed as "another great step" and "AMERICA IS BACK" [T4-009099](#T4-009099); Trump's first-year accomplishments called "extraordinary" [T4-008945](#T4-008945); Rudy Giuliani heading a new cyber security committee welcomed [T4-005909](#T4-005909); crowds in Poland greeting Trump [T4-008455](#T4-008455); and a list of "wins" (Oval Office, Senate, House, Supreme Court, record markets, Flotus) [T4-004979](#T4-004979).
- Attacking Democrats, the left and media: an NBC poll dismissed as a "shitpie" with insults at those who shared it [T4-004144](#T4-004144); a Maine ad blamed on George Soros and a "deep state anti-#MAGA agenda," urging calls to Sen. Collins and the NYT [T4-009068](#T4-009068); Democrats' "A Better Deal" translated as higher middle-class taxes [T4-008594](#T4-008594); media outlets lumped together in a hostile hashtag list [T4-009512](#T4-009512); Russia coverage called baseless and "shameful" [T4-007101](#T4-007101); a stolen laptop with Trump Tower floor plans tagged with #OBAMAGATE/#ShadowGovernment [T4-007077](#T4-007077); and 2016-era "Just say NO #NeverHillary #TrumpPence16" [T4-004024](#T4-004024).
- Movement/policy slogans and mobilization: recurring #BuildTheWall/#SecureTheBorder and border-crossing imagery ("invaders") [T4-007272](#T4-007272) [T4-004036](#T4-004036); #DrainTheSwamp, #TCOT, #BuildTheWall with a "shine the light of freedom" message [T4-007884](#T4-007884); calls to "Join the march" with #tcot/#pjnet [T4-008600](#T4-008600); praise of a "billionaire who quit his job to work for us" around CPAC/CNNLeaks [T4-009524](#T4-009524); and hashtag-only amplification [T4-009031](#T4-009031) plus a mass-mention loyalty post urging viewership of Hannity and belief in @GenFlynn [T4-009120](#T4-009120).

Note: this is a bounded retrieval of 20 posts out of 91 matching posts, so it is not a representative sample of all activity.
